test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an election there were two candidates Ram Singh and Sohan Lal. The total no. of voters in the constituency was 80000 and 80% of the total votes were polled. If 60% of the polled votes were cast in favour of Ram Singh, how many votes were received by Sohan Lal?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Total no. of voters is 80,000

80% of the total votes were polled

Ram singh received 60% of polled votes

**CALCULATION:**

Here, total no. of voters = 80,000

Total no, of votes polled = 80,000 × 80/100 = 64,000

As, Ram Singh got 60% of polled votes. 

So, Sohan Lal got 40% of polled votes 

⇒ 64,000 × 40/100 = 25,600

**Hence, Sohan lal received 25600 votes.**
